effect_sizes.name: within-level Spearman(EPR, R) at alpha=0.95, lam=1.2, 3x3
effect_sizes.method: null band ~ 2/sqrt(n) for zero correlation; reversal = below threshold across conditions

n_justification: 60 games per (lambda, alpha) cell (40 for the 4x4 check); a Spearman of magnitude 0.3 is ~2.3 sigma at n=60, and the claim is the SIGN pattern across independent conditions, not any single cell.
notes: F-0010: the INITIAL criterion (non-positive at alpha=0.95 in >=3/4 conditions; written before this run but not externally locked, so 'ex-ante hypothesis', not 'pre-registered') FAILED 2/4 — revised, with the failure documented, to the pattern the data supports: coupling COLLAPSE at alpha=0.95 in all conditions and both sizes. The sign pattern is lambda-DEPENDENT across the three lambdas tested (+0.25 -> +0.03 -> -0.23; -0.26 at 4x4) but individual signs sit within ~2 null-SD (0.13 at n=60): the robust fact is the collapse; the sign trend is suggestive data, not a claim. See findings F-0010.
